LanguageData.OverwriteModeDesc: This option controls the approach when another mod has already configured slots for the weapon.\n- If enabled, it will remove the original configuration and add slots to all weapons.\n- If disabled, it will use the original configuration.
LanguageData.AddColorDesc: When enabled, CompColorable from CWF will be added to weapon, which will cause weapon randomly colored currently.
LanguageData.AddRenameDesc: When enabled, weapons will be renameable on customize panel.
LanguageData.RemoveColorComps: Remove all colors on weapon of this map (After clicking, save & load your save file to take effect)
